prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one ORIGINAL MASTER painting for one Bhagavad Gita verse in a Sanskrit reader. Generate a single PORTRAIT 9:16 image, 1080x1920 or the highest actually supported native portrait resolution close to 9:16. Consistent series style: refined traditional Indian watercolor and restrained gouache on warm ivory handmade paper; fine organic detail, subtle ochre, sage, dusty terracotta and muted indigo; dignified ancient Indian setting, quiet atmospheric daylight. The image must illustrate THIS VERSE'S ACTUAL MEANING. Read the exact source meaning below; derive a concrete, intelligible scene or a restrained symbolic interpretation of that teaching. Never simply paint an unrelated chariot, generic temple or anonymous landscape. Compose one coherent scene, no collage or infographic. Keep important faces, hands, relationships and narrative objects inside the central 70% of width and central 70% of height, surrounded by ample low-detail sky, ground and paper atmosphere. No important subject cut by an edge. This one master must support portrait/landscape phones and tablets through safe proportional fitting. No text of any kind, no verse number, no letters, no Sanskrit/Roman typography, no watermark, no frame, no UI. Text will be rendered separately by the app over the image at a user-adjustable default image opacity of 48%. If Krishna is depicted, maintain a youthful calm blue-skinned figure in muted golden-yellow garments, a restrained peacock-feather crown, no modern jewelry. Arjuna is a dark-haired warrior with a small crown, bow and understated bronze armor. Use them only when the meaning warrants them; the scene or analogy remains verse-specific.  Reference (DO NOT DRAW THIS TEXT): Bhagavad Gītā 17.7. Exact Sanskrit: आहारस्त्वपि सर्वस्य त्रिविधो भवति प्रियः ।
यज्ञस्तपस्तथा दानं तेषां भेदमिमं शृणु ॥ ७ ॥ Exact stored meaning: Even the food that is dear to all is of three kinds; and so too are sacrifice, austerity, and charity threefold. Hear now of this distinction. Chapter context: Threefold faith, foods, sacrifice, austerity, speech, charity and sacred utterance. Paint the specified type or practice. No Sanskrit letters or written sacred syllables inside the image. Previous verse context only, do not substitute for the target: Torturing the aggregate of elements within the body, and also Me who dwells within the body — know these senseless ones to be of demoniac resolve. Next verse context only, do not substitute for the target: Foods that promote longevity, vitality, strength, health, happiness, and delight — which are flavourful, smooth, substantial, and pleasing to the heart — are dear to the sāttvika. Final instruction: center the distinctive content of the TARGET meaning, not the neighboring verses. No fabricated teaching or unrelated religious scene. Phone-first composition update, owner 2026-10-19: phones are the primary reading device, tablets secondary. Keep the complete meaningful scene compact and intelligible at 320–430 logical pixels wide. Arrange the important relationships as one close, coherent central grouping; avoid essential tiny distant figures and wide edge-to-edge action. Keep generous quiet margins on all four sides, no faces, hands, feet, narrative objects or important background subjects touching the frame. The complete portrait painting will be contained inside the phone reading area, never stretched or cropped to fill it; do not depend on edge cropping. Preserve the approved watercolor style and the exact verse meaning. No labels, letters, sacred syllables, explanatory marks or typography. Portrait-format owner update 2026-10-19: create a genuinely tall 9:16 painted composition for phone reading, not a square painting pasted on blank portrait paper. The atmosphere and natural scene should continue organically through the portrait canvas. Keep all important subjects wholly visible, inside quiet margins; no frame-edge clipping. Use one coherent compact narrative group, with detail readable on a phone. This same portrait painting is reused proportionally on tablets and landscape screens; do not create a second image for tablets. Visual review correction: the previous draft became a pictorial comparison table. Reject that structure. Paint ONE continuous natural ancient Indian ashram courtyard scene in tall 9:16 watercolor: Krishna calmly explains to Arjuna beneath a tree; a modest meal of rice, fruit and vegetables sits naturally in the foreground. In the same physically continuous courtyard, at a smaller background scale, a household offers at a simple sacred fire, a contemplative person meditates, and a person gives a bowl to an elder. These naturally placed actions evoke the food, offering, austerity and charity actually named in this introductory verse. Do not enumerate their three kinds here as a visual chart. Absolutely no rows, horizontal divider lines, columns, tiles, separate panels, circular vignettes, teaching-table arrangement, infographic, text, letters, sacred syllables, color-coded labels or annotation marks. Use one shared perspective, ground plane, light and natural background. Keep the complete main speakers, hands and meal within quiet margins, readable on phones. Preserve the approved ivory/ochre/sage/terracotta/indigo watercolor style.
review_note: Contact-sheet inspection; conservative full-frame safe region preserves all figures and objects.

entry.alt: Interpretive watercolor for Bhagavad Gītā 17.7: Even the food that is dear to all is of three kinds; and so too are sacrifice, austerity, and charity threefold. Hear now of this distinction.
